actual_scope: On the edge layout p=2^{24}-2, ell=24, r_max=4, decide whether the envelope ratio 12 is at most p/6400.
scope_change_reason: PR #4925 left this comparison open after showing the edge ratio equals 12. The successive sixteenth walks are closed. This package compares 12*6400 with 16777214. It does not search for a larger ratio and does not claim a new kappa.
bottleneck_link: The printed product uses the coefficient p/6400. On this edge the ratio is 12, and 12*6400 is strictly below p, so the ratio lies strictly below that coefficient. The selected frontier is unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop after the integer comparison of 12*6400 with p on this one edge layout. Do not evaluate C_E and do not search for the maximum ratio.
author: James Reed
no_open_questions_reason: PR #4925 asked only whether 12 is at most p/6400 on this edge. The comparison holds, and the exact quotient is part of the result. C_E remains the unevaluated common factor already excluded from that question. Searching for a larger ratio was excluded by the predecessor. No further comparison of this edge ratio is posed.
